title: A scheduled firing announced and handled

groundTruth.schedule: tester-ds's hourly-open-work schedule: every hour at a fixed minute, channel bakeoff-team, prompt 'Scheduled check: list the work units still open in this channel, one line each, and say which need a decision from a person. If none are open, say so in one line.'
groundTruth.spec: §4.2 a schedule is declared, never created; the announcement is the operator's own words posted by the system bot; a missed occurrence fires once; the agent marks it handled with triggers::resolve; the open units are in the prompt (§3.15)

pass: The system bot posted the schedule's prompt verbatim, mentioning tester-ds, within the sweep interval of the declared minute; tester-ds's turn listed the open units as the store holds them (or said none are open), said which need a person, and called triggers::resolve; the listing afterwards shows nothing outstanding.

checks.text: The announcement's body equals the declared prompt and its create_at is within 60 s after the declared minute.
Every unit and state in the reply matches units.json for this channel; no unit is invented and no open one is omitted.
triggers::resolve was called with the announcement's id; the driver's /collegium triggers note shows nothing outstanding.
The reply is proportionate to a scheduled check (no narration of the schedule mechanism).
